email-login-challenge-v1.goal: Keep a bounded, one-time email login challenge until expiry; loss requires requesting a new code.
email-login-challenge-v1.entry: Read the existing email verification challenge by the purpose-scoped key and atomically consume it after verifying the HMAC.
prerequisites: The existing Cloud authentication MongoDB and HMAC key remain available.
A lost or expired challenge cannot be reconstructed and requires a new code request.

email-login-challenge-v1.atomicDomain: One document in the existing email_verification_challenges collection.
email-login-challenge-v1.fencing: A unique purpose-scoped key and conditional single-document update prevent replay; registration keys are distinct.

resources.responsibility: Store expiring, purpose-separated registration and login email verification challenges.
resources.growth: At most one login challenge per normalized email alongside existing registration challenges; existing send limits and the TTL index bound retention.
